editorial.blurb: Samiflorencia brings the warmth and authenticity of African cuisine to the city, where every dish tastes made with love and the service feels like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive near closing time and you'll still get fresh, hot food—plus the team treats late diners with the same care and complimentary vegetable soup as anyone else.

topDishes.note: Consistently praised as the best in the city, comes with fufu and meat already included
Delicious and a standout when prepared well
